events.title: European Shares Seen Tad Higher At Open As Oil Extends Slide
events.description: European stocks are likely to open higher on Wednesday as investors keep a close eye on developments between the U.S. and Iran, and look forward to a crucial U.S.-China summit on Thursday, which could lead to new trade agreements amid escalating competition and restrictions on advanced technologies.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Higher In Early Trade
events.description: Indian shares are moving higher in early trade on Wednesday as Brent crude futures extended losses for a sixth consecutive session on hopes for progress in U.S.-Iran talks and reports suggesting that Saudi Arabia has restarted its East-West oil pipeline.

events.title: Australian Market Trims Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is trimming its early gains in mid-market moves on Wednesday, but extending the gains in the previous two sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 staying above the 8,750 level, with gains in mining stocks partially offset by weakness in energy and technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Higher
events.description: Asian markets are mostly higher on Wednesday, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, amid optimism about a diplomatic resolution to the US-Iran conflict after US and Iranian officials held a three-hour meeting on the sidelines of the UN gathering. The continued fall in crude oil prices also eased global inflation concerns and the possibility of another interest rate hike this year.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Little Changed At Open
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening flat to slightly higher on Wednesday after reports suggested that Saudi Arabia has restarted its East-West oil pipeline and may have resumed exports from the Red Sea port of Yanbu following drone attacks on September 11.

events.title: Thai Stock Market Tipped To Open Under Water On Wednesday
events.description: The Thai stock market has moved higher in four straight sessions, collecting more than 40 points or 2.7 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just beneath the 1,605-point plateau although it's likely to open to the downside on Wednesday.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Tick Higher On Wednesday
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has finished lower in three straight sessions, surrendering almost 190 points or 3 percent in that span. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 6,275-point plateau although it's due for support on Wednesday.

events.title: Rally May Stall For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has climbed higher in three straight sessions, improving more than 480 points or 1.9 percent in that span. The Hang Seng Index now sits just above the 25,080-point plateau although it's looking at a soft start on Wednesday.

events.title: Australian Market Modestly Higher
events.description: Australian shares are trading modestly higher on Wednesday, extending the gains in the previous two sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 moving well above the 8,750 level, with gains in mining stocks partially offset by weakness in energy and technology stocks.

events.title: China Stock Market May Spin Its Wheels On Wednesday
events.description: The China stock market has finished higher in three straight sessions, climbing more than 75 points or 1.7 percent in that span. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,950-point plateau although it may open in the red on Wednesday.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market Due For Consolidation
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has tracked higher in five straight sessions, surging more than 2,880 points or 6.4 percent along the way. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 47,800-point plateau although it's likely to run out of steam on Wednesday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market May Run Out Of Steam On Wednesday
events.description: The Singapore stock market has finished higher in two straight sessions, gathering almost 70 points or 1.2 percent along the way. The Straits Times Index now sits just above the 5,720-point plateau although it may spin its wheels on Wednesday.

events.title: Little Movement Seen For Malaysia Stock Market
events.description: The Malaysia stock market has moved higher in back-to-back sessions, collecting almost 20 points or 1.2 percent in that span. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,680-point plateau although it may be stuck in neutral on Wednesday.
